body.name: DpadT
body.def: For \(T\ge T_0\), \(D_T^{\mathrm{pad}}\) is computed at the grid \(\Delta(b(T))\mathbb Z\cap[0,T]\) from the constrained and unconstrained GCMs of \(\mathbb W(t)+t^2\) restricted to \([-R(b(T)),T+R(b(T))]\), with the energy integral restricted to the same padded interval.
